# assess_text_diversity { #dyf.assess_text_diversity }

```python
assess_text_diversity(
    titles,
    *,
    min_unique_tokens=50,
    min_token_ratio=0.01,
    min_unique_title_ratio=0.05,
)
```

Cheaply assess whether a title collection has enough diversity for LLM labeling.

Single O(n) pass: collects unique tokens (via tokenize()) and unique title strings.
Returns a report with three signals and a boolean gate.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                   | Type                           | Description                                          | Default    |
|------------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| titles                 | [list](`list`)\[[str](`str`)\] | List of title strings.                               | _required_ |
| min_unique_tokens      | [int](`int`)                   | Minimum unique token count to be considered diverse. | `50`       |
| min_token_ratio        | [float](`float`)               | Minimum ratio of unique tokens to total items.       | `0.01`     |
| min_unique_title_ratio | [float](`float`)               | Minimum ratio of unique titles to total titles.      | `0.05`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                    | Description                                                      |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [TextDiversityReport](`dyf.splits.TextDiversityReport`) | TextDiversityReport with is_diverse=True if all thresholds pass. |
